title: ByteHound canonical protocol configuration, schema_version 1
description: Typed, pre-expansion form of the configuration tables (Documentation/config_json_format.md). The application checks the same structure in code (app/decoder/validation.py::check_structure) and then applies the loader's semantic rules; this file is for tools and documentation.

tables.description: One entry per configuration table (protocol, frames, variables, frame_config, bitfields, enums, calc_groups, tx_commands, tx_command_fields, serial_defaults, polling_schedule, sequence_counters, value_rules). Column names are kept as written in the source.

extra_tables.description: Sheets / files the loader does not use (e.g. readme), kept so nothing is lost on a round trip.

import.description: Where the configuration came from. Excluded from the fingerprint.

extensions.description: Columns the loader does not know, kept as text.

additionalProperties.description: A column value: a number or true/false when that converts back to the source text exactly, otherwise the source text.
